name: pulsewatch
description: PulseWatch - API monitoring and incident management platform

scripts.build: corepack pnpm build:shared && corepack pnpm --filter @pulsewatch/api build && corepack pnpm --filter @pulsewatch/web build
scripts.build:api: corepack pnpm build:shared && corepack pnpm --filter @pulsewatch/api build
scripts.build:web: corepack pnpm build:shared && corepack pnpm --filter @pulsewatch/web build
scripts.dev: corepack pnpm build:shared && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "corepack pnpm --filter @pulsewatch/api dev" "corepack pnpm --filter @pulsewatch/web dev"
scripts.dev:api: corepack pnpm build:shared && corepack pnpm --filter @pulsewatch/api dev
scripts.dev:web: corepack pnpm build:shared && corepack pnpm --filter @pulsewatch/web dev
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm build:shared && corepack pnpm -r typecheck
scripts.test: corepack pnpm build:shared && corepack pnpm --filter @pulsewatch/api test && corepack pnpm --filter @pulsewatch/web test
scripts.test:api: corepack pnpm build:shared && corepack pnpm --filter @pulsewatch/api test
scripts.test:api:integration: corepack pnpm build:shared && corepack pnpm --filter @pulsewatch/api test:integration
scripts.test:api:e2e: corepack pnpm build:shared && corepack pnpm --filter @pulsewatch/api test:e2e
scripts.test:web: corepack pnpm build:shared && corepack pnpm --filter @pulsewatch/web test
scripts.test:coverage: corepack pnpm build:shared && corepack pnpm --filter @pulsewatch/api test:coverage && corepack pnpm --filter @pulsewatch/web test:coverage
